description: Search WikiPathways (open community pathway database) for biological pathways by name. Pathways map genes/proteins/metabolites in processes like glycolysis, apoptosis, or signaling. Optionally restrict to one organism by Latin or common name. Keyless. Complements KEGG/Reactome.

organism.description: Optional. Restrict to an organism by Latin or common name, e.g. "Homo sapiens" or "human".

query.description: Text to match in the pathway name (case-insensitive), e.g. "glycolysis", "apoptosis".

name: search_pathways
title: Search Pathways
